notes: Amendments 23 and 24 (reviews/M2_CODE_NOTE_2026-10-30d.md). q0754 was cancelled; this re-runs the dry run on the code with the sibling member-count fix (code_sha 64b5dee0b1788c040071eafdd2b345c759c26a71a274b461315d650cdf491de2, design sha256 ff342ff36f815b5cce6851cb1c4526a4daf0829ba5e033012704c80f3bd9b98c (amendment 24: earlier units excluded from left_before_overdue_slot and end_date_missing)). Fresh store path. Not queued. Original q0754 notes follow. DRAFT (not in jobs/). SHOULD 3 of the final verification (text l.20, section 22): the host dry run uses a rule ledger of END-OF-WINDOW size. How it is simulated: the dry run (and only the dry run; run_pass refuses a pad outside a dry-run spec) pads the append-only rule ledger with m2_spec.DRYRUN_LEDGER_PAD = 800,000 inert synthetic records over 250,000 synthetic markets (negative ids, no real market is touched, no unit changes; test_the_ledger_stops_merging_once_the_window_is_folded_and_a_pad_is_inert), before the first pass. Basis: M2-J0 (section 21) committed 109,264 row + 183,901 hash records over 11 day files = 26,651 records a day; J1's first pass reads about 8 retained days and merges through the 21-day window, then stops merging, so about 30 days = 800,000 records; markets assumed 250,000 against J0's 107,798. Over-stating the size only makes the check stricter. The padded ledger is written into the dry store's state file at every capture (state sha chain exercised at full size) and re-loaded on resume. Measured on the laptop with the padded ledger and no captures: 295 MB RSS after loading the state file (165 MB of it is the import baseline), 370 MB while staging it. Store name m2_ch264_dryrun under a directory named research_lab is required by the runner (it refuses the real store with --dry-run-last-days). The dry run derives a window of the last 3 days from the newest capture (spec_sha differs from the real one by construction; the real pins - design text, eight modules, lexicon - are kept and checked). Window time is simulated by now = end + 7 h so every slot is decidable. Code: backend/scripts/run_m2.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m2_spec.py, m2_j1.py, m2_j2.py, m2_readout.py, m2_analysis.py (code_sha in the unit lines). Pins checked at start (exit 3 with expected and actual values on a mismatch, exit 2 on a declared refusal). Do not run beside a multi-GB job (memory rule).
